findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how provision, following, and arrival belong to one movement: access has been achieved, but access does not erase the communication threshold.
findings.containment: The relation keeps the literal travel and literal interval in place. It does not turn the journey into a purely metaphorical path or claim that every later scene is one abstract route.
